meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 与 LazyCodex 安装,揪出过时或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用 LazyCodex 或 Codex,想确认本地安装健康、与最新版一致。
copy.tagline_en: Check Codex and LazyCodex installs for drift, staleness, or breakage.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and worry your local install may be unhealthy or outdated.

howto.what: 它会检查你本机的 LazyCodex 与 Codex CLI 安装,和最新源码逐项对比,输出一份 PASS/WARN/FAIL 体检报告,每条结论都注明是哪个命令输出或文件得出的。它只做诊断,不动你的安装、配置和仓库,除非你之后明确要求修复。
howto.when: 当你要求做 doctor 或健康检查、提到 LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai、omo-codex 等关键词,或 Codex 在安装、更新、改配置后表现异常、你怀疑本地安装陈旧或损坏时触发。

say.text: 帮我跑一次 LazyCodex 体检,看看 Codex 安装是否健康
say.note: 先同步最新源码,再逐项检查并出报告

say.text: 我更新 Codex 之后行为有点怪,诊断一下配置和插件
say.note: 输出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告并给出修复建议

say.text: 检查我的 LazyCodex 安装是不是比最新版本旧了
say.note: 对比已装版本与最新源码,报告漂移

howto.what_en: It inspects your local LazyCodex and Codex CLI install, compares it with the latest sources, and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report citing evidence for each verdict. Diagnosis only — no changes unless you ask.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a doctor or health check, mention LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai or omo-codex, or when Codex acts oddly after an install, update or config change, or you suspect a broken setup.

say_en.text: Run a LazyCodex doctor check and tell me if my Codex install is healthy
say_en.note: Syncs latest sources, then reports each check

say_en.text: Codex acts weird after I updated it — diagnose my config and plugin
say_en.note: Returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with fixes

say_en.text: Is my installed LazyCodex older than the latest source?
say_en.note: Compares installed vs latest for drift
